verdict.rationale: Within its hosted platform, Cactus documents AI-generated suggestions from user-supplied input. POST /tool_schemas turns a product description into three to five suggested tool definitions, and POST /generations synthesizes training examples from your tools and example messages. These are narrow generation features, not insights drawn from a user's data. Missing for 10: insights or analysis over the user's own data or results, in-product suggestion surfaces in the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these platform features.
